clinical_application_and_analysis_part.caa7_association_analysis: Whole-brain ROI comparisons (ASD vs TD) after self-normalization and ComBat batch correction with Bonferroni multiple-comparisons correction; ASD classification using LMFGCN with 10-fold cross-validation, achieving accuracy >81.77%.
clinical_application_and_analysis_part.caa8_key_findings_brief: ASD shows distinct cortical developmental trajectories: early increased SA and GV with thinner CT, converging around 8–10 years then decreasing; LMFGCN outperforms alternative classifiers for ASD vs TD.
clinical_application_and_analysis_part.caa9_key_findings_detailed: GAMLSS-derived trajectories indicate age-related cortical thinning across lifespan in both groups, with ASD thinner CT and larger SA/GV during ~0–8 years, curves intersecting ~8–10 years then declining. ROI analyses reveal largely nonoverlapping abnormal CT and SA patterns. The LMFGCN framework, integrating modality-specific GCNs with low-rank tensor fusion, exceeded other methods with classification accuracy reported >81.77% under 10-fold CV.
clinical_application_and_analysis_part.caa11_application_notes: Intermediate integration (LMFGCN) combining GCNs with low-rank multi-model tensor fusion; age-specific preprocessing (Infant FreeSurfer; ANTs+FreeSurfer); ComBat harmonization prior to ROI tests.

caa10_key_limitations.answer: Multi-site and sex differences remain challenging despite controls; classification requires replication on independent datasets; trajectories are drawn from cross-sectional data—longitudinal studies needed.

general_note_part.gn1_general_notes: KQJH acquisition used sedation with 10% chloral hydrate to reduce motion; KQJH QC text lists 59 inaccurately segmented scans yet states 107 excluded—final sample counts suggest 107 is correct. Code availability mentions 'GAMSS' which likely refers to GAMLSS.
